reason: The current evidence lacks direct information about the storm that surpassed Typhoon Nora in 2015 and its intensification timeline. Deriving bridge notes can help organize raw evidence to clarify target types and support future evidence gathering for the question.

derived_candidates.text: Hurricane Hattie originated from an area of low pressure that strengthened into a tropical storm on October 27.
Hurricane Camille quickly intensified into a Category 2 hurricane before striking on August 15.
Typhoon Elsie intensified further, becoming a Category 5 super typhoon hours before making landfall in Luzon.
